episodes.title: Purgatory
episodes.summary: Wynonna Earp returns to her hometown of Purgatory when she learns that someone--or something--killed her uncle. She's reunited with her younger sister Waverly, and learns that the Earp curse is alive and well.

episodes.title: Keep the Home Fires Burning
episodes.summary: Using the name "Henry," Doc makes contact with the Earps and gets work as their handyman. Meanwhile, the revenants' leader Bobo Del Rey demands that Doc prove his loyalty by summoning the Shadow Assassin to kill the Heir. Meanwhile, Xavier instructs Wynonna in the rudiments of demon-hunting but she's not particularly interested in following orders.

episodes.title: Leavin' on Your Mind
episodes.summary: Three revenants go into the city to cut off an innocent murderer's hand, and then steal a diary belonging to a deaf-mute poet. Wynonna and Xavier soon realize that they're preparing to cast a spell... which will let them go over the line.

episodes.title: The Blade
episodes.summary: After Doc convinces Wynonna that he is who he claims, he helps the team track down a revenant who kills the unforgiven by striking through reflective surfaces.

episodes.title: Diggin' Up Bones
episodes.summary: Wynonna and Xavier convince the local judge to give them a search warrant to go after Bobo. They turn up nothing, but a revenant contacts them with a lead on the remaining members of the Seven. Meanwhile, the Stone Witch bails Bobo out of jail.

episodes.title: Constant Cravings
episodes.summary: Wynonna identifies a member of the Seven from his neck brand in the photo, and the trail leads to a cannibal revenant. Meanwhile, Waverly discovers that Curtis left her a gift, Doc discovers more of what Constance is up to, and Xavier tries to get the solution to his hidden addiction.

episodes.title: Walking After Midnight
episodes.summary: While the last member of the Seven stalks Wynonna at the sheriff's station, Constance launches an attack on the homestead where Waverly is holding an engagement party for a friend.

episodes.title: Two-Faced Jack
episodes.summary: When Wynonna goes missing, Xavier and Doc form a temporary alliance to find her. Meanwhile, Wynonna finds the last member of the Seven, who plans to operate on her... whether she wants it or not.

episodes.title: Bury Me with My Guns On
episodes.summary: After killing the last of the Seven, Wynonna wonders what to do with her life now that she's had her revenge. A new opportunity soon arises when Doc tracks down Constance and needs help dealing with the Stone Witch. Meanwhile, Waverly approaches Nicole while Neadley helps Xavier blend in with the community.

episodes.title: She Wouldn't Be Gone
episodes.summary: Wynonna and Xavier learn that there's a revenant with a weapon that Bobo fears, and goes looking for him. Meanwhile, Doc considers leaving Purgatory, and Wynonna learns what Xavier has been hiding.

episodes.title: Landslide
episodes.summary: Cryderman unleashes his own plan to dispose of Xavier and the Earps, while Wynonna and Waverly deal with the return of their sister. Meanwhile, Doc tries to leave Purgatory and receives a warning from an enigmatic stranger.

episodes.title: House of Memories
episodes.summary: Bobo makes his move to acquire the Lead and escape the Ghost River Triangle. Meanwhile, Willa remembers her past and who freed her from Bobo.

episodes.title: I Walk the Line
episodes.summary: Bobo and his double-agent make their attempt to escape the Triangle, and Wynonna discovers that the curse does more than just keep the revenants in Purgatory. Meanwhile, Lucado takes measures against Xavier, and Neadley chooses a side.

episodes.title: Steel Bars and Stone Walls
episodes.summary: Wynonna and her friends try to rescue a seemingly mutated Dolls and meet a new ally. Meanwhile, Lucado prepares to send Dolls to a black site - permanently. There may be more to Waverly than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Shed Your Skin
episodes.summary: Doc and Wynonna meet up with some old friends. Meanwhile, Doc makes a deal with Lucado after he becomes a businessman, and Waverly and Nicole have their first fight. While Waverly's change accelerates and Doc makes a dangerous deal, Wynonna must fight spider creatures.

episodes.title: Gonna Getcha Good
episodes.summary: Doc and Rosita continue trying to reverse-engineer the serum. Meanwhile, Wynonna deals an angry Marzanoik, a djinn-like demon, going after the Class of 2007 hockey team to collect its due.

episodes.title: She Ain't Right
episodes.summary: A demon steals a case from a Black Badge courier containing a "super weapon," and Waverly agrees to go undercover to recover it. Meanwhile, Wynonna brings dolls to Doc and Rosita so that they can administer the cure, and convinces Jeremy to help them.

episodes.title: Let's Pretend We're Strangers
episodes.summary: Wynonna struggles against the passenger demon, and Waverly realizes that there's only one way to save her. Meanwhile, Dolls and Lucado form an uneasy alliance to sop the demon from spreading throughout Purgatory.

episodes.title: Whiskey Lullaby
episodes.summary: The Widows place Purgatory under a sleep curse so that they can recover the second seal, and Wynonna and her team try to stop them before it's too late.

episodes.title: Everybody Knows
episodes.summary: While Wynonna takes Nicole to a strip bar to find out who the father of her child is, Doc, Dolls, and Jeremy deal with ghostly gunfighters from Doc's past.

episodes.title: No Future in the Past
episodes.summary: With Juan Carlo's help, Wynonna travels into the past to learn the origins of the Earp curse... and the origins of two of her enemies. Meanwhile, Waverly, Nicole, and Rosita prepare to throw Wynonna a baby shower, and Wynonna continues to deal with her coming motherhood.

episodes.title: Forever Mine Nevermind
episodes.summary: Under the influence of a demon spell, Wynonna and Doc say what's really on their minds. Meanwhile, Waverly and Rosita bond over a spa night, and Dolls and Jeremy go Widow-hunting.

episodes.title: I See a Darkness
episodes.summary: The team tries to save Nicole after she's bitten by a Widow. Waverly makes a deal with an Iron Witch, while Jeremy tries to create an antidote using Dolls and Rosita as guinea pigs. Meanwhile, Wynonna and Doc try to track down Beth, who has abducted Nedley.

episodes.title: Gone as a Girl Can Get
episodes.summary: In the new reality, Waverly is getting married, Doc runs the revenants, and Dolls and Jeremy run the Black Badge division by themselves. Doc is the only one who remembers how things were before the wish, and must find a way to bring Wynonna back.

episodes.title: I Hope You Dance
episodes.summary: The team struggles against the Widows, the Order, Bobo and revenants to keep Wynonna alive, long enough to give birth to her baby.

episodes.title: Blood Red and Going Down
episodes.summary: Several months after Wynonna loses her daughter, she and her team defend Purgatory from vampires as they try to track down the freed demon Bulshar.

episodes.title: When You Call My Name
episodes.summary: After the crash, Wynonna struggles for survival while a revenant takes Waverly home for dinner. Meanwhile, Doc contemplates his now-mortal existence, and Xavier finds his supply of the drug dangerously low.

episodes.title: Colder Weather
episodes.summary: The team mourns the loss of one of their own and decides what to do next.

episodes.title: No Cure for Crazy
episodes.summary: While Waverly visits Michelle at the institute, Jeremy makes a new friend and Doc goes looking for them in the forest.

episodes.title: Jolene
episodes.summary: Doc, Nicole, and the Earps argue over their personal differences under Jolene's influence, and Doc pays a visit to Bobo.

episodes.title: If We Make It Through December
episodes.summary: Michelle prepares a big Christmas dinner, and Wynonna finds a new ally. Meanwhile, Doc and Kate have a heart-to-heart, and Nedley freezes up when Bulshar takes a boy out from under the sheriff's nose.

episodes.title: I Fall to Pieces
episodes.summary: Nedley has Wynonna and Nicole clean out a closet filled with old supernatural relics, and they break a mirror that frees a mountain man who settles on one of them to become his wife. Meanwhile, Michelle takes her leave of Purgatory with Doc's help.

episodes.title: Waiting Forever for You
episodes.summary: Wynonna goes after Kate to either kill her or find out what Bulshar is up to, and Doc teams up with Charlie to deal with a resurrected Stone Witch. Meanwhile, Waverly and Nicole throw a dinner party for Jeremy and Robin.

episodes.title: Undo It
episodes.summary: Wynonna and Doc find themselves caught in Bulshar's magical trap, while Jeremy, Waverly, and Nicole rush to free them.

episodes.title: The Other Woman
episodes.summary: A mysterious woman shows up at the Earp homestead and tells Wynonna that there's still a way to kill Bulshar even without Peacemaker. Meanwhile, Doc, Jeremy, and Nicole try to get Juan Carlo's journal back since it has the answers to defeating Bulshar.

episodes.title: Daddy Lessons
episodes.summary: After discovering that she's lost Peacemaker, the Revenants capture Wynonna and turn her over to Bulshar. Meanwhile, Charlie takes Waverly out of Purgatory and she learns more about her origins, while Nicole comes to Kate's aid.

episodes.title: War Paint
episodes.summary: Bulshar executes his final ploy to enter the Garden as a mortal. Meanwhile, Jeremy finds a way to get past the beekeepers, and Charlie makes the ultimate sacrifice to save Nicole's life.

episodes.title: On the Road Again
episodes.summary: Wynonna Earp races to find a way into the Garden before her sister is trapped forever.

episodes.title: Friends in Low Places
episodes.summary: Wynonna works with a new ally to rescue her family, but reunions come at a price.

episodes.title: Look at Them Beans
episodes.summary: Wynonna finds herself on the wrong side of the law and Doc partners with a new demon.

episodes.title: Afraid
episodes.summary: Wynonna faces down an ancient enemy as Waverly and Nicole search for help.

episodes.title: Holy War: Part 1
episodes.summary: Trouble at the Homestead leads to payback time for a deadly deal.

episodes.title: Holy War: Part 2
episodes.summary: The gang races to save one of their own, but are hindered by unseen forces.

episodes.title: Love's All Over
episodes.summary: Love is in the air as Waverly and Nicole celebrate their engagement with an enchanted evening.

episodes.title: Hell Raisin' Good Time
episodes.summary: Wynonna and Waverly have a Halloween they'll never forget; Rotten Jack terrorizes Purgatory.

episodes.title: Crazy
episodes.summary: It's Trivia Night in Purgatory and that can only mean murder, mayhem and brain sandwiches.

episodes.title: Life Turned Her That Way
episodes.summary: A deadly foe re-emerges in the Ghost River Triangle, intent on finishing what they started.

episodes.title: Better Dig Two
episodes.summary: Wynonna and Waverly take two very different and dangerous paths in an effort to save Purgatory.

episodes.title: Old Souls
episodes.summary: Big feelings and bigger decisions are revealed when a new witch makes herself known in Purgatory.
